response.original_title: Krull & Birk: Two Minds – One Canvas
response.overview: Two of Aarhus' most visionary artists, Peter Birk and Hans Krull, meet on a joint project: to paint two monumental murals on Aarhus Ø. A portrait of two iconoclasts who insist on leaving a mark on the city around them – and on each other.
response.title: Krull & Birk: Two Minds – One Canvas
